title: schilleria oblonga
intro: Schilleria oblonga, commonly known as the "Tinospora oblonga" or "Guduchi", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Menispermaceae. Guduchi is an herb that has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Guduchi include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-diabetic and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Guduchi include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
